# BIONIC Emergency Services LLC

> 24/7 restoration services in Houston, TX.

BIONIC Emergency Services LLC (BIONIC Emergency Services LLC) is a professional restoration contractor serving Houston, TX and surrounding areas since 2011. We provide 24/7 emergency response for water, fire, mold, storm, biohazard, and reconstruction services. Phone: (713) 338-2424 · Email: shane@bionic24365.com.
